text:
maya: Trying to scale a new GPU spot pool in us-west-2 and keeps failing during network setup. EC2 prints 429s from the SG API and instances never finish booting. Anyone seen security group rule creation throttling lately?

alex: Yep, hit this in perf test last night. Error shows up as `ClientError: Rate exceeded` when calling AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress. It blocks our init script which writes 50 rules per instance.

luke: Ugh. We create a lot of transient SG rules for per-VM NAT/firewall. Might be hitting either per-account API request rate or per-SG rule-add limits.

sre-oncall: Short-term mitigation: stop the autoscaler, fall back to a pre-warmed pool with reusable SGs. Long-term: need quota bump + change pattern to reuse rules.

alex: Log snippet:```
failed to authorize ingress: ClientError: Rate exceeded
  cmd: /usr/bin/aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc1234 --ip-permissions file://rules.json
```

cloud-ops-bot: Created support case AWS-789012 (console link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home?caseId=AWS-789012) — requesting increases for: `Security group rules per security group` and `EC2 API request rate` in us-west-2. ETA from AWS pending.

maya: Thanks — we need the timeline. This is blocking a customer rollout and GPU nodes sit idle earlier than expected. Any quick config we can change to reduce calls?

luke: Two quick changes: 1) Move rule creation to a single init step per pool (one SG for N instances). 2) Use the AWS `replace-security-group-entries` style batch call (where available) instead of per-rule calls. Also add exponential backoff on failures.

alex: I raised a Service Quotas request for: `Security groups per network interface`, `Security group rules per security group`, and `EC2 API request rate` (submitted via console). Ticket ID: SQ-45711 — link in the case notes.

aws-support-bot: AWS response: "Limit increase requests acknowledged. Typical propagation 24-72 hours. Meanwhile consider reducing rule churn and using fewer security groups per instance. We recommend using fewer, larger rules and avoid creating/deleting SGs at scale."

sre-oncall: Temporary action plan: 1) Pause scale-up for new customers (maya, please hold deployments). 2) Reconfigure autoscaler to 5 nodes / 10 min ramp for this region. 3) Deploy a shared SG template and update instance bootstrap to attach existing SG instead of creating. 4) Monitor CloudWatch API Throttle metrics and case updates.

maya: Pausing now. I'll attach the shared SG patch and restart small batch once AWS gives OK or we confirm reduced API usage. Will post status in this thread. :thumbsup:

alex: Also putting a note in runbook: avoid per-pod SGs until quotas are increased.

cloud-ops-bot: Monitoring rule: CloudWatch metric (EC2:ApiCallRate) alerted 5x in last 30m; silenced while we triage.

maya: Update — AWS acknowledged case and said they can expedite to 24h for this account. If we still see 429s after quota change, we'll need code changes. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
